1.text: Adam, Sheth, Enosh,
Kenan, Mahalaleel, Jered,
Henoch, Methuselah, Lamech,
Noah, Shem, Ham, N Japheth.
Tha sons of Japheth; Gomer, N Magog, N Madai, N Javan, N Tubal, N Meshech, N Tiras.
N tha sons of Gomer; Ashchenaz, N Riphath, N Togarmah.
N tha sons of Javan; Elishah, N Tarshish, Kittim, N Dodanim.
Tha sons of Ham; Cush, N Mizraim, Put, N Canaan.
N tha sons of Cush; Seba, N Havilah, N Sabta, N Raamah, N Sabtecha. N tha sons of Raamah; Sheba, N Dedan.
N Cush fathered Nimrod: he began 2 be mighty upon tha earth.
N Mizraim fathered Ludim, N Anamim, N Lehabim, N Naphtuhim,
N Pathrusim, N Casluhim, (of whom came tha Philistines,) N Caphthorim.
N Canaan fathered Zidon his firstborn, N Heth,
Tha Jebusite also, N tha Amorite, N tha Girgashite,
N tha Hivite, N tha Arkite, N tha Sinite,
N tha Arvadite, N tha Zemarite, N tha Hamathite.
Tha sons of Shem; Elam, N Asshur, N Arphaxad, N Lud, N Aram, N Uz, N Hul, N Gether, N Meshech.
N Arphaxad fathered Shelah, N Shelah fathered Eber.
N 2 Eber were born two sons: tha name of tha one was Peleg; because in his days tha earth was divided: N his brother’s name was Joktan.
N Joktan fathered Almodad, N Sheleph, N Hazarmaveth, N Jerah,
Hadoram also, N Uzal, N Diklah,
N Ebal, N Abimael, N Sheba,
N Ophir, N Havilah, N Jobab. All dese were tha sons of Joktan.
Shem, Arphaxad, Shelah,
Eber, Peleg, Reu,
Serug, Nahor, Terah,
Abram; tha same is Abraham.
Tha sons of Abraham; Isaac, N Ishmael.
Dese r their generations: tha firstborn of Ishmael, Nebaioth; then Kedar, N Adbeel, N Mibsam,
Mishma, N Dumah, Massa, Hadad, N Tema,
Jetur, Naphish, N Kedemah. dese r tha sons of Ishmael.
Now tha sons of Keturah, Abraham’s concubine: she bare Zimran, N Jokshan, N Medan, N Midian, N Ishbak, N Shuah. N tha sons of Jokshan; Sheba, N Dedan.
N tha sons of Midian; Ephah, N Epher, N Henoch, N Abida, N Eldaah. All dese r tha sons of Keturah.
N Abraham fathered Isaac. tha sons of Isaac; Esau N Israel.
Tha sons of Esau; Eliphaz, Reuel, N Jeush, N Jaalam, N Korah.
Tha sons of Eliphaz; Teman, N Omar, Zephi, N Gatam, Kenaz, N Timna, N Amalek.
Tha sons of Reuel; Nahath, Zerah, Shammah, N Mizzah.
N tha sons of Seir; Lotan, N Shobal, N Zibeon, N Anah, N Dishon, N Ezer, N Dishan.
N tha sons of Lotan; Hori, N Homam: N Timna was Lotan’s sister.
Tha sons of Shobal; Alian, N Manahath, N Ebal, Shephi, N Onam. N tha sons of Zibeon; Aiah, N Anah.
Tha sons of Anah; Dishon. N tha sons of Dishon; Amram, N Eshban, N Ithran, N Cheran.
Tha sons of Ezer; Bilhan, N Zavan, N Jakan. tha sons of Dishan; Uz, N Aran.
Now dese r tha kings dat reigned in tha land of Edom before any king reigned over tha children of Israel; Bela tha son of Beor: N tha name of his city was Dinhabah.
N when Bela was dead, Jobab tha son of Zerah of Bozrah reigned in his stead.
N when Jobab was dead, Husham of tha land of tha Temanites reigned in his stead.
N when Husham was dead, Hadad tha son of Bedad, which struck Midian in tha field of Moab, reigned in his stead: N tha name of his city was Avith.
N when Hadad was dead, Samlah of Masrekah reigned in his stead.
N when Samlah was dead, Shaul of Rehoboth by tha river reigned in his stead.
N when Shaul was dead, Baal-hanan tha son of Achbor reigned in his stead.
N when Baal-hanan was dead, Hadad reigned in his stead: N tha name of his city was Pai; N his wife’s name was Mehetabel, tha daughter of Matred, tha daughter of Mezahab.
Hadad died also. N tha dukes of Edom were; duke Timnah, duke Aliah, duke Jetheth,
Duke Aholibamah, duke Elah, duke Pinon,
Duke Kenaz, duke Teman, duke Mibzar,
Duke Magdiel, duke Iram. dese r tha dukes of Edom.

2.text: Dese r tha sons of Israel; Reuben, Simeon, Levi, N Judah, Issachar, N Zebulun,
Dan, Joseph, N Benjamin, Naphtali, Gad, N Asher.
Tha sons of Judah; Er, N Onan, N Shelah: which three were born 2 him of tha daughter of Shua tha Canaanitess. N Er, tha firstborn of Judah, was evil in tha sight of tha LORD; N he killed him.
N Tamar his daughter in law bare him Pharez N Zerah. All tha sons of Judah were five.
Tha sons of Pharez; Hezron, N Hamul.
N tha sons of Zerah; Zimri, N Ethan, N Heman, N Calcol, N Dara: five of ’em in all.
N tha sons of Carmi; Achar, tha troubler of Israel, who transgressed in tha thing accursed.
N tha sons of Ethan; Azariah.
Tha sons also of Hezron, dat were born 2 him; Jerahmeel, N Ram, N Chelubai.
N Ram fathered Amminadab; N Amminadab fathered Nahshon, prince of tha children of Judah;
N Nahshon fathered Salma, N Salma fathered Boaz,
N Boaz fathered Obed, N Obed fathered Jesse,
N Jesse fathered his firstborn Eliab, N Abinadab tha second, N Shimma tha third,
Nethaneel tha fourth, Raddai tha fifth,
Ozem tha sixth, David tha seventh:
Whose sisters were Zeruiah, N Abigail. N tha sons of Zeruiah; Abishai, N Joab, N Asahel, three.
N Abigail bare Amasa: N tha father of Amasa was Jether tha Ishmeelite.
N Caleb tha son of Hezron fathered children of Azubah his wife, N of Jerioth: her sons r dese; Jesher, N Shobab, N Ardon.
N when Azubah was dead, Caleb took 2 him Ephrath, which bare him Hur.
N Hur fathered Uri, N Uri fathered Bezaleel.
N afterward Hezron went in 2 tha daughter of Machir tha father of Gilead, whom he married when he was threescore years old; N she bare him Segub.
N Segub fathered Jair, who had three N twenty citiez in tha land of Gilead.
N he took Geshur, N Aram, wit tha towns of Jair, from ’em, wit Kenath, N tha towns of it, even threescore citiez. All dese belonged 2 tha sons of Machir tha father of Gilead.
N after dat Hezron was dead in Caleb-ephratah, then Abiah Hezron’s wife bare him Ashur tha father of Tekoa.
N tha sons of Jerahmeel tha firstborn of Hezron were, Ram tha firstborn, N Bunah, N Oren, N Ozem, N Ahijah.
Jerahmeel had also another wife, whose name was Atarah; she was tha mother of Onam.
N tha sons of Ram tha firstborn of Jerahmeel were, Maaz, N Jamin, N Eker.
N tha sons of Onam were, Shammai, N Jada. N tha sons of Shammai; Nadab, N Abishur.
N tha name of tha wife of Abishur was Abihail, N she bare him Ahban, N Molid.
N tha sons of Nadab; Seled, N Appaim: but Seled died without children.
N tha sons of Appaim; Ishi. N tha sons of Ishi; Sheshan. N tha children of Sheshan; Ahlai.
N tha sons of Jada tha brother of Shammai; Jether, N Jonathan: N Jether died without children.
N tha sons of Jonathan; Peleth, N Zaza. dese were tha sons of Jerahmeel.
Now Sheshan had no sons, but daughters. N Sheshan had a servant, an Egyptian, whose name was Jarha.
N Sheshan gave his daughter 2 Jarha his servant 2 wife; N she bare him Attai.
N Attai fathered Nathan, N Nathan fathered Zabad,
N Zabad fathered Ephlal, N Ephlal fathered Obed,
N Obed fathered Jehu, N Jehu fathered Azariah,
N Azariah fathered Helez, N Helez fathered Eleasah,
N Eleasah fathered Sisamai, N Sisamai fathered Shallum,
N Shallum fathered Jekamiah, N Jekamiah fathered Elishama.
Now tha sons of Caleb tha brother of Jerahmeel were, Mesha his firstborn, which was tha father of Ziph; N tha sons of Mareshah tha father of Hebron.
N tha sons of Hebron; Korah, N Tappuah, N Rekem, N Shema.
N Shema fathered Raham, tha father of Jorkoam: N Rekem fathered Shammai.
N tha son of Shammai was Maon: N Maon was tha father of Beth-zur.
N Ephah, Caleb’s concubine, bare Haran, N Moza, N Gazez: N Haran fathered Gazez.
N tha sons of Jahdai; Regem, N Jotham, N Geshan, N Pelet, N Ephah, N Shaaph.
Maachah, Caleb’s concubine, bare Sheber, N Tirhanah.
She bare also Shaaph tha father of Madmannah, Sheva tha father of Machbenah, N tha father of Gibea: N tha daughter of Caleb was Achsah.
Dese were tha sons of Caleb tha son of Hur, tha firstborn of Ephratah; Shobal tha father of Kirjath-jearim,
Salma tha father of Beth-lehem, Hareph tha father of Beth-gader.
N Shobal tha father of Kirjath-jearim had sons; Haroeh, N half of tha Manahethites.
N tha families of Kirjath-jearim; tha Ithrites, N tha Puhites, N tha Shumathites, N tha Mishraites; of ’em came tha Zareathites, N tha Eshtaulites.
Tha sons of Salma; Beth-lehem, N tha Netophathites, Ataroth, tha house of Joab, N half of tha Manahethites, tha Zorites.
N tha families of tha scribes which lived at Jabez; tha Tirathites, tha Shimeathites, N Suchathites. dese r tha Kenites dat came of Hemath, tha father of tha house of Rechab.

3.text: Now dese were tha sons of David, which were born 2 him in Hebron; tha firstborn Amnon, of Ahinoam tha Jezreelitess; tha second Daniel, of Abigail tha Carmelitess:
Tha third, Absalom tha son of Maachah tha daughter of Talmai king of Geshur: tha fourth, Adonijah tha son of Haggith:
Tha fifth, Shephatiah of Abital: tha sixth, Ithream by Eglah his wife.
Dese six were born 2 him in Hebron; N there he reigned seven years N six months: N in Jerusalem he reigned thirty N three years.
N dese were born 2 him in Jerusalem; Shimea, N Shobab, N Nathan, N Solomon, four, of Bath-shua tha daughter of Ammiel:
Ibhar also, N Elishama, N Eliphelet,
N Nogah, N Nepheg, N Japhia,
N Elishama, N Eliada, N Eliphelet, nine.
Dese were all tha sons of David, beside tha sons of tha concubines, N Tamar their sister.
N Solomon’s son was Rehoboam, Abia his son, Asa his son, Jehoshaphat his son,
Joram his son, Ahaziah his son, Joash his son,
Amaziah his son, Azariah his son, Jotham his son,
Ahaz his son, Hezekiah his son, Manasseh his son,
Amon his son, Josiah his son.
N tha sons of Josiah were, tha firstborn Johanan, tha second Jehoiakim, tha third Zedekiah, tha fourth Shallum.
N tha sons of Jehoiakim: Jeconiah his son, Zedekiah his son.
N tha sons of Jeconiah; Assir, Salathiel his son,
Malchiram also, N Pedaiah, N Shenazar, Jecamiah, Hoshama, N Nedabiah.
N tha sons of Pedaiah were, Zerubbabel, N Shimei: N tha sons of Zerubbabel; Meshullam, N Hananiah, N Shelomith their sister:
N Hashubah, N Ohel, N Berechiah, N Hasadiah, Jushab-hesed, five.
N tha sons of Hananiah; Pelatiah, N Jesaiah: tha sons of Rephaiah, tha sons of Arnan, tha sons of Obadiah, tha sons of Shechaniah.
N tha sons of Shechaniah; Shemaiah: N tha sons of Shemaiah; Hattush, N Igeal, N Bariah, N Neariah, N Shaphat, six.
N tha sons of Neariah; Elioenai, N Hezekiah, N Azrikam, three.
N tha sons of Elioenai were, Hodaiah, N Eliashib, N Pelaiah, N Akkub, N Johanan, N Dalaiah, N Anani, seven.

4.text: Tha sons of Judah; Pharez, Hezron, N Carmi, N Hur, N Shobal.
N Reaiah tha son of Shobal fathered Jahath; N Jahath fathered Ahumai, N Lahad. dese r tha families of tha Zorathites.
N dese were of tha father of Etam; Jezreel, N Ishma, N Idbash: N tha name of their sister was Hazelelponi:
N Penuel tha father of Gedor, N Ezer tha father of Hushah. dese r tha sons of Hur, tha firstborn of Ephratah, tha father of Beth-lehem.
N Ashur tha father of Tekoa had two wives, Helah N Naarah.
N Naarah bare him Ahuzam, N Hepher, N Temeni, N Haahashtari. dese were tha sons of Naarah.
N tha sons of Helah were, Zereth, N Jezoar, N Ethnan.
N Coz fathered Anub, N Zobebah, N tha families of Aharhel tha son of Harum.
N Jabez was more honourable than his brothers: N his mother called his name Jabez, sayin, Because I bare him wit sorrow.

N Jabez called on tha God of Israel, sayin, Oh dat u would bless me indeed, N enlarge my coast, N dat thine hand might be wit me, N dat u would keep me from evil, dat it may not grieve me! N God granted him dat which he requested.
N Chelub tha brother of Shuah fathered Mehir, which was tha father of Eshton.
N Eshton fathered Beth-rapha, N Paseah, N Tehinnah tha father of Ir-nahash. dese r tha men of Rechah.
N tha sons of Kenaz; Othniel, N Seraiah: N tha sons of Othniel; Hathath.
N Meonothai fathered Ophrah: N Seraiah fathered Joab, tha father of tha valley of Charashim; 4 dey were craftsmen.
N tha sons of Caleb tha son of Jephunneh; Iru, Elah, N Naam: N tha sons of Elah, even Kenaz.
N tha sons of Jehaleleel; Ziph, N Ziphah, Tiria, N Asareel.
N tha sons of Ezra were, Jether, N Mered, N Epher, N Jalon: N she bare Miriam, N Shammai, N Ishbah tha father of Eshtemoa.
N his wife Jehudijah bare Jered tha father of Gedor, N Heber tha father of Socho, N Jekuthiel tha father of Zanoah. N dese r tha sons of Bithiah tha daughter of Pharaoh, which Mered took.
N tha sons of his wife Hodiah tha sister of Naham, tha father of Keilah tha Garmite, N Eshtemoa tha Maachathite.
N tha sons of Shimon were, Amnon, N Rinnah, Ben-hanan, N Tilon. N tha sons of Ishi were, Zoheth, N Ben-zoheth.
Tha sons of Shelah tha son of Judah were, Er tha father of Lecah, N Laadah tha father of Mareshah, N tha families of tha house of ’em dat wrought fine linen, of tha house of Ashbea,
N Jokim, N tha men of Chozeba, N Joash, N Saraph, who had tha dominion in Moab, N Jashubi-lehem. N dese r ancient things.
Dese were tha potters, N dose dat lived among plants N hedges: there dey lived wit tha king 4 his work.
Tha sons of Simeon were, Nemuel, N Jamin, Jarib, Zerah, N Shaul:
Shallum his son, Mibsam his son, Mishma his son.
N tha sons of Mishma; Hamuel his son, Zacchur his son, Shimei his son.
N Shimei had sixteen sons N six daughters; but his brothers had not many children, neither did all their family multiply, like 2 tha children of Judah.
N dey lived at Beer-sheba, N Moladah, N Hazar-shual,
N at Bilhah, N at Ezem, N at Tolad,
N at Bethuel, N at Hormah, N at Ziklag,
N at Beth-marcaboth, N Hazar-susim, N at Beth-birei, N at Shaaraim. dese were their citiez 2 tha reign of David.
N their villages were, Etam, N Ain, Rimmon, N Tochen, N Ashan, five citiez:
N all their villages dat were round about tha same citiez, 2 Baal. dese were their habitations, N their genealogy.
N Meshobab, N Jamlech, N Joshah tha son of Amaziah,
N Joel, N Jehu tha son of Josibiah, tha son of Seraiah, tha son of Asiel,
N Elioenai, N Jaakobah, N Jeshohaiah, N Asaiah, N Adiel, N Jesimiel, N Benaiah,
N Ziza tha son of Shiphi, tha son of Allon, tha son of Jedaiah, tha son of Shimri, tha son of Shemaiah;
Dese mentioned by their namez were princes in their families: N tha house of their fathers increased greatly.
N dey went 2 tha entrance of Gedor, even 2 tha east side of tha valley, 2 seek pasture 4 their flocks.
N dey found fat pasture N good, N tha land was wide, N quiet, N peaceable; 4 dey of Ham had lived there of old.

N dese written by name came in tha days of Hezekiah king of Judah, N struck their tents, N tha habitations dat were found there, N destroyed ’em utterly 2 dis day, N lived in their rooms: because there was pasture there 4 their flocks.
N some of ’em, even of tha sons of Simeon, five hundred men, went 2 mount Seir, havin 4 their captains Pelatiah, N Neariah, N Rephaiah, N Uzziel, tha sons of Ishi.
N dey struck tha rest of tha Amalekites dat were escaped, N lived there 2 dis day.

5.text: Now tha sons of Reuben tha firstborn of Israel, (4 he was tha firstborn; but, forasmuch as he defiled his father’s bed, his birthright was given 2 tha sons of Joseph tha son of Israel: N tha genealogy is not 2 be reckoned after tha birthright.
4 Judah prevailed above his brothers, N of him came tha chief ruler; but tha birthright was Joseph’s:)
Tha sons, I say, of Reuben tha firstborn of Israel were, Hanoch, N Pallu, Hezron, N Carmi.
Tha sons of Joel; Shemaiah his son, Gog his son, Shimei his son,
Micah his son, Reaia his son, Baal his son,
Beerah his son, whom Tilgath-pilneser king of Assyria carried away captive: he was prince of tha Reubenites.
N his brothers by their families, when tha genealogy of their generations was reckoned, were tha chief, Jeiel, N Zechariah,
N Bela tha son of Azaz, tha son of Shema, tha son of Joel, who lived in Aroer, even 2 Nebo N Baal-meon:
N eastward he inhabited 2 tha entering in of tha wilderness from tha river Euphrates: because their cattle were multiplied in tha land of Gilead.
N in tha days of Saul dey made war wit tha Hagarites, who fell by their hand: N dey lived in their tents throughout all tha east land of Gilead.
N tha children of Gad lived over against ’em, in tha land of Bashan 2 Salchah:
Joel tha chief, N Shapham tha next, N Jaanai, N Shaphat in Bashan.
N their brothers of tha house of their fathers were, Michael, N Meshullam, N Sheba, N Jorai, N Jachan, N Zia, N Heber, seven.
Dese r tha children of Abihail tha son of Huri, tha son of Jaroah, tha son of Gilead, tha son of Michael, tha son of Jeshishai, tha son of Jahdo, tha son of Buz;
Ahi tha son of Abdiel, tha son of Guni, chief of tha house of their fathers.
N dey lived in Gilead in Bashan, N in her towns, N in all tha suburbs of Sharon, upon their borders.
All dese were reckoned by genealogies in tha days of Jotham king of Judah, N in tha days of Jeroboam king of Israel.

Tha sons of Reuben, N tha Gadites, N half tha tribe of Manasseh, of valiant men, men able 2 bear buckler N sword, N 2 shoot wit bow, N skilful in war, were four N forty thousand seven hundred N threescore, dat went out 2 tha war.
N dey made war wit tha Hagarites, wit Jetur, N Nephish, N Nodab.
N dey were helped against ’em, N tha Hagarites were delivered in2 their hand, N all dat were wit ’em: 4 dey cried 2 God in tha battle, N he was intreated of ’em; because dey put their trust in him.
N dey took away their cattle; of their camels fifty thousand, N of sheep two hundred N fifty thousand, N of asses two thousand, N of men an hundred thousand.
4 there fell down many killed, because tha war was of God. N dey lived in their steads until tha captivity.
N tha children of tha half tribe of Manasseh lived in tha land: dey increased from Bashan 2 Baal-hermon N Senir, N 2 mount Hermon.
N dese were tha heads of tha house of their fathers, even Epher, N Ishi, N Eliel, N Azriel, N Jeremiah, N Hodaviah, N Jahdiel, mighty men of valour, famous men, N heads of tha house of their fathers.
N dey transgressed against tha God of their fathers, N went a whoring after tha gods of tha people of tha land, whom God destroyed before ’em.

N tha God of Israel stirred up tha spirit of Pul king of Assyria, N tha spirit of Tilgath-pilneser king of Assyria, N he carried ’em away, even tha Reubenites, N tha Gadites, N tha half tribe of Manasseh, N brought ’em 2 Halah, N Habor, N Hara, N 2 tha river Gozan, 2 dis day.

6.text: Tha sons of Levi; Gershon, Kohath, N Merari.
N tha sons of Kohath; Amram, Izhar, N Hebron, N Uzziel.
N tha children of Amram; Aaron, N Moses, N Miriam. tha sons also of Aaron; Nadab, N Abihu, Eleazar, N Ithamar.
Eleazar fathered Phinehas, Phinehas fathered Abishua,
N Abishua fathered Bukki, N Bukki fathered Uzzi,
N Uzzi fathered Zerahiah, N Zerahiah fathered Meraioth,
Meraioth fathered Amariah, N Amariah fathered Ahitub,
N Ahitub fathered Zadok, N Zadok fathered Ahimaaz,
N Ahimaaz fathered Azariah, N Azariah fathered Johanan,
N Johanan fathered Azariah, (he it is dat executed tha priest’s office in tha temple dat Solomon built in Jerusalem:)
N Azariah fathered Amariah, N Amariah fathered Ahitub,
N Ahitub fathered Zadok, N Zadok fathered Shallum,
N Shallum fathered Hilkiah, N Hilkiah fathered Azariah,
N Azariah fathered Seraiah, N Seraiah fathered Jehozadak,
N Jehozadak went in2 captivity, when tha LORD carried away Judah N Jerusalem by tha hand of Nebuchadnezzar.
Tha sons of Levi; Gershom, Kohath, N Merari.
N dese be tha namez of tha sons of Gershom; Libni, N Shimei.
N tha sons of Kohath were, Amram, N Izhar, N Hebron, N Uzziel.
Tha sons of Merari; Mahli, N Mushi. N dese r tha families of tha Levites according 2 their fathers.
Of Gershom; Libni his son, Jahath his son, Zimmah his son,
Joah his son, Iddo his son, Zerah his son, Jeaterai his son.
Tha sons of Kohath; Amminadab his son, Korah his son, Assir his son,
Elkanah his son, N Ebiasaph his son, N Assir his son,
Tahath his son, Uriel his son, Uzziah his son, N Shaul his son.
N tha sons of Elkanah; Amasai, N Ahimoth.
As 4 Elkanah: tha sons of Elkanah; Zophai his son, N Nahath his son,
Eliab his son, Jeroham his son, Elkanah his son.
N tha sons of Samuel; tha firstborn Vashni, N Abiah.
Tha sons of Merari; Mahli, Libni his son, Shimei his son, Uzza his son,
Shimea his son, Haggiah his son, Asaiah his son.
N dese r dey whom David set over tha service of song in tha house of tha LORD, after dat tha ark had rest.

N dey ministered before tha livin place of tha tabernacle of tha congregation wit singin, until Solomon had built tha house of tha LORD in Jerusalem: N then dey waited on their office according 2 their order.
N dese r dey dat waited wit their children. Of tha sons of tha Kohathites: Heman a singer, tha son of Joel, tha son of Shemuel,
Tha son of Elkanah, tha son of Jeroham, tha son of Eliel, tha son of Toah,
Tha son of Zuph, tha son of Elkanah, tha son of Mahath, tha son of Amasai,
Tha son of Elkanah, tha son of Joel, tha son of Azariah, tha son of Zephaniah,
Tha son of Tahath, tha son of Assir, tha son of Ebiasaph, tha son of Korah,
Tha son of Izhar, tha son of Kohath, tha son of Levi, tha son of Israel.
N his brother Asaph, who stood on his right hand, even Asaph tha son of Berachiah, tha son of Shimea,
Tha son of Michael, tha son of Baaseiah, tha son of Malchiah,
Tha son of Ethni, tha son of Zerah, tha son of Adaiah,
Tha son of Ethan, tha son of Zimmah, tha son of Shimei,
Tha son of Jahath, tha son of Gershom, tha son of Levi.
N their brothers tha sons of Merari stood on tha left hand: Ethan tha son of Kishi, tha son of Abdi, tha son of Malluch,
Tha son of Hashabiah, tha son of Amaziah, tha son of Hilkiah,
Tha son of Amzi, tha son of Bani, tha son of Shamer,
Tha son of Mahli, tha son of Mushi, tha son of Merari, tha son of Levi.
Their brothers also tha Levites were appointed 2 all manner of service of tha tabernacle of tha house of God.

But Aaron N his sons offered upon tha altar of tha burnt offering, N on tha altar of incense, N were appointed 4 all tha work of tha place most holy, N 2 make an atonement 4 Israel, according 2 all dat Moses tha servant of God had commanded.
N dese r tha sons of Aaron; Eleazar his son, Phinehas his son, Abishua his son,
Bukki his son, Uzzi his son, Zerahiah his son,

Then tha spirit came upon Amasai, who was chief of tha captains, N he said, Thine r we, David, N on ur side, u son of Jesse: peace, peace be 2 u, N peace be 2 thine helpers; 4 ur God helpeth u. Then David received ’em, N made ’em captains of tha band.

N there fell some of Manasseh 2 David, when he came wit tha Philistines against Saul 2 battle: but dey helped ’em not: 4 tha lords of tha Philistines upon advisement sent him away, sayin, He will fall 2 his master Saul 2 tha jeopardy of our heads.

4 at dat time day by day there came 2 David 2 help him, until it was a great host, like tha host of God.
N dese r tha numbers of tha bands dat were ready armed 2 tha war, N came 2 David 2 Hebron, 2 turn tha kingdom of Saul 2 him, according 2 tha word of tha LORD.

N of Asher, such as went forth 2 battle, expert in war, forty thousand.
N on tha other side of Jordan, of tha Reubenites, N tha Gadites, N of tha half tribe of Manasseh, wit all manner of instruments of war 4 tha battle, an hundred N twenty thousand.

N there dey were wit David three days, eatin N drinkin: 4 their brothers had prepared 4 ’em.

Moreover dey dat were nigh ’em, even 2 Issachar N Zebulun N Naphtali, brought bread on asses, N on camels, N on mules, N on oxen, N food, meal, cakes of figs, N bunches of raisins, N wine, N oil, N oxen, N sheep abundantly: 4 there was joy in Israel.

13.text: N David consulted wit tha captains of thousands N hundreds, N wit every leader.

N David said 2 all tha congregation of Israel, If it seem good 2 u, N dat it be of tha LORD our God, let us send abroad 2 our brothers every where, dat r left in all tha land of Israel, N wit ’em also 2 tha priests N Levites which r in their citiez N suburbs, dat dey may gather themselves 2 us:
N let us bring again tha ark of our God 2 us: 4 we enquired not at it in tha days of Saul.
N all tha congregation said dat dey would do so: 4 tha thing was right in tha eyes of all tha people.
So David gathered all Israel together, from Shihor of Egypt even 2 tha entering of Hemath, 2 bring tha ark of God from Kirjath-jearim.
N David went up, N all Israel, 2 Baalah, dat is, 2 Kirjath-jearim, which belonged 2 Judah, 2 bring up thence tha ark of God tha LORD, dat lives between tha cherubims, whose name is called on it.

N when dey came 2 tha threshingfloor of Chidon, Uzza put forth his hand 2 hold tha ark; 4 tha oxen stumbled.

N David was displeased, because tha LORD had made a breach upon Uzza: so dat place is called Perez-uzza 2 dis day.

N tha ark of God remained wit tha family of Obed-edom in his house three months. N tha LORD blessed tha house of Obed-edom, N all dat he had.

14.text: Now Hiram king of Tyre sent messengers 2 David, N timber of cedars, wit masons N carpenters, 2 build him an house.

N David took more wives at Jerusalem: N David fathered more sons N daughters.
Now dese r tha namez of his children which he had in Jerusalem; Shammua, N Shobab, Nathan, N Solomon,
N Ibhar, N Elishua, N Elpalet,
N Nogah, N Nepheg, N Japhia,
N Elishama, N Beeliada, N Eliphalet.
N when tha Philistines heard dat David was anointed king over all Israel, all tha Philistines went up 2 seek David. N David heard of it, N went out against ’em.

N it will be, when u will hear a sound of goin in tha tops of tha mulberry trees, dat then u will go out 2 battle: 4 God is gone forth before u 2 strike tha host of tha Philistines.
David therefore did as God commanded him: N dey struck tha host of tha Philistines from Gibeon even 2 Gazer.
N tha fame of David went out in2 all lands; N tha LORD brought tha fear of him upon all nations.

15.text: N David made him houses in tha city of David, N prepared a place 4 tha ark of God, N pitched 4 it a tent.

N David gathered all Israel together 2 Jerusalem, 2 bring up tha ark of tha LORD 2 his place, which he had prepared 4 it.
N David assembled tha children of Aaron, N tha Levites:
Of tha sons of Kohath; Uriel tha chief, N his brothers an hundred N twenty:
Of tha sons of Merari; Asaiah tha chief, N his brothers two hundred N twenty:
Of tha sons of Gershom; Joel tha chief, N his brothers an hundred N thirty:
Of tha sons of Elizaphan; Shemaiah tha chief, N his brothers two hundred:

N David called 4 Zadok N Abiathar tha priests, N 4 tha Levites, 4 Uriel, Asaiah, N Joel, Shemaiah, N Eliel, N Amminadab,
N said 2 ’em, y’all r tha chief of tha fathers of tha Levites: sanctify y’all, both y’all N ur brothers, dat y’all may bring up tha ark of tha LORD God of Israel 2 tha place dat I have prepared 4 it.
4 because y’all did it not at tha first, tha LORD our God made a breach upon us, 4 dat we sought him not after tha due order.

N tha children of tha Levites bare tha ark of God upon their shoulders wit tha staves thereon, as Moses commanded according 2 tha word of tha LORD.
N David spoke 2 tha chief of tha Levites 2 appoint their brothers 2 be tha singers wit instruments of musick, psalteries N harps N cymbals, sounding, by liftin up tha voice wit joy.
So tha Levites appointed Heman tha son of Joel; N of his brothers, Asaph tha son of Berechiah; N of tha sons of Merari their brothers, Ethan tha son of Kushaiah;

N wit ’em their brothers of tha second degree, Zechariah, Ben, N Jaaziel, N Shemiramoth, N Jehiel, N Unni, Eliab, N Benaiah, N Maaseiah, N Mattithiah, N Elipheleh, N Mikneiah, N Obed-edom, N Jeiel, tha porters.
So tha singers, Heman, Asaph, N Ethan, were appointed 2 sound wit cymbals of brass;
N Zechariah, N Aziel, N Shemiramoth, N Jehiel, N Unni, N Eliab, N Maaseiah, N Benaiah, wit psalteries on Alamoth;
N Mattithiah, N Elipheleh, N Mikneiah, N Obed-edom, N Jeiel, N Azaziah, wit harps on tha Sheminith 2 excel.
N Chenaniah, chief of tha Levites, was 4 song: he instructed about tha song, because he was skilful.

N David was clothed wit a robe of fine linen, N all tha Levites dat bare tha ark, N tha singers, N Chenaniah tha master of tha song wit tha singers: David also had upon him an ephod of linen.

16.text: So dey brought tha ark of God, N set it in tha midst of tha tent dat David had pitched 4 it: N dey offered burnt sacrifices N peace offerings before God.

N he dealt 2 every one of Israel, both man N woman, 2 every one a loaf of bread, N a good piece of flesh, N a flagon of wine.
N he appointed certain of tha Levites 2 minister before tha ark of tha LORD, N 2 record, N 2 thank N praise tha LORD God of Israel:
Asaph tha chief, N next 2 him Zechariah, Jeiel, N Shemiramoth, N Jehiel, N Mattithiah, N Eliab, N Benaiah, N Obed-edom: N Jeiel wit psalteries N wit harps; but Asaph made a sound wit cymbals;
Benaiah also N Jahaziel tha priests wit trumpets continually before tha ark of tha covenant of God.
Then on dat day David delivered first dis psalm 2 thank tha LORD in2 tha hand of Asaph N his brothers.
Give thanks 2 tha LORD, call upon his name, make known his deeds among tha people.

Seek tha LORD N his strength, seek his face continually.
Remember his marvellous works dat he has done, his wonders, N tha judgments of his mouth;
O y’all seed of Israel his servant, y’all children of Jacob, his chosen ones.
He is tha LORD our God; his judgments r in all tha earth.
Be y’all mindful always of his covenant; tha word which he commanded 2 a thousand generations;
Even of tha covenant which he made wit Abraham, N of his oath 2 Isaac;
N has confirmed tha same 2 Jacob 4 a law, N 2 Israel 4 an everlasting covenant,
Sayin, 2 u will I give tha land of Canaan, tha lot of ur inheritance;
When y’all were but few, even a few, N strangers in it.
N when dey went from nation 2 nation, N from one kingdom 2 another people;
He suffered no man 2 do ’em wrong: yeah, he reproved kings 4 their sakes,
Sayin, Touch not mine anointed, N do my prophets no harm.
Sing 2 tha LORD, all tha earth; show forth from day 2 day his salvation.

4 great is tha LORD, N greatly 2 be praised: he also is 2 be feared above all gods.
4 all tha gods of tha people r idols: but tha LORD made tha heavenz.
Glory N honour r in his presence; strength N gladness r in his place.

N say y’all, Save us, O God of our salvation, N gather us together, N deliver us from tha heathen, dat we may give thanks 2 ur holy name, N glory in ur praise.
Blessed be tha LORD God of Israel 4 ever N ever. N all tha people said, Amen, N praised tha LORD.
So he left there before tha ark of tha covenant of tha LORD Asaph N his brothers, 2 minister before tha ark continually, as every day’s work required:
N Obed-edom wit their brothers, threescore N eight; Obed-edom also tha son of Jeduthun N Hosah 2 be porters:
N Zadok tha priest, N his brothers tha priests, before tha tabernacle of tha LORD in tha high place dat was at Gibeon,
2 offer burnt offerings 2 tha LORD upon tha altar of tha burnt offering continually morning N evening, N 2 do according 2 all dat is written in tha law of tha LORD, which he commanded Israel;
N wit ’em Heman N Jeduthun, N tha rest dat were chosen, who were expressed by name, 2 give thanks 2 tha LORD, because his mercy endures 4 ever;
N wit ’em Heman N Jeduthun wit trumpets N cymbals 4 dose dat should make a sound, N wit musical instruments of God. N tha sons of Jeduthun were porters.

17.text: Now it happened, as David sat in his house, dat David said 2 Nathan tha prophet, look, I live in an house of cedars, but tha ark of tha covenant of tha LORD remains under curtains.
Then Nathan said 2 David, Do all dat is in thine heart; 4 God is wit u.
N it happened tha same night, dat tha word of God came 2 Nathan, sayin,
Go N tell David my servant, like dis says tha LORD, u will not build me an house 2 live in:
4 I have not lived in an house since tha day dat I brought up Israel 2 dis day; but have gone from tent 2 tent, N from one tabernacle 2 another.
Wherever I have walked wit all Israel, spoke I a word 2 any of tha judges of Israel, whom I commanded 2 feed my people, sayin, Why have y’all not built me an house of cedars?
Now therefore like dis will u say 2 my servant David, like dis says tha LORD of hosts, I took u from tha sheepcote, even from followin tha sheep, dat u should be ruler over my people Israel:
N I have been wit u wherever u have walked, N have cut off all thine opps from before u, N have made u a name like tha name of tha great men dat r in tha earth.

N since tha time dat I commanded judges 2 be over my people Israel. Moreover I will subdue all thine opps. Furthermore I tell u dat tha LORD will build u an house.
N it will happen, when ur days be expired dat u must go 2 be wit ur fathers, dat I will raise up ur seed after u, which shall be of ur sons; N I will establish his kingdom.

But I will settle him in mine house N in my kingdom 4 ever: N his throne shall be established 4 evermore.
According 2 all dese words, N according 2 all dis vision, so did Nathan speak 2 David.
N David tha king came N sat before tha LORD, N said, Who am I, O LORD God, N what is mine house, dat u have brought me until now?
N yet dis was a small thing in ur eyes, O God; 4 u have also spoken of ur servant’s house 4 a great while 2 come, N have regarded me according 2 tha estate of a man of high degree, O LORD God.
What can David speak more 2 u 4 tha honour of ur servant? 4 u know ur servant.
O LORD, 4 ur servant’s sake, N according 2 ur own heart, have u done all dis greatness, in makin known all dese great things.
O LORD, there is none like u, neither is there any God beside u, according 2 all dat we have heard wit our ears.

N what one nation in tha earth is like ur people Israel, whom God went 2 redeem 2 be his own people, 2 make u a name of greatness N terribleness, by driving out nations from before ur people, whom u have redeemed out of Egypt?
4 ur people Israel did u make ur own people 4 ever; N u, LORD, becamest their God.
Therefore now, LORD, let tha thing dat u have spoken concerning ur servant N concerning his house be established 4 ever, N do as u have said.
Let it even be established, dat ur name may be magnified 4 ever, sayin, tha LORD of hosts is tha God of Israel, even a God 2 Israel: N let tha house of David ur servant be established before u.
4 u, O my God, have told ur servant dat u will build him an house: therefore ur servant has found in his heart 2 pray before u.
N now, LORD, u r God, N have promised dis goodness 2 ur servant:
Now therefore let it please u 2 bless tha house of ur servant, dat it may be before u 4 ever: 4 u bless, O LORD, N it will be blessed 4 ever.

18.text: Now after dis it happened, dat David struck tha Philistines, N subdued ’em, N took Gath N her towns out of tha hand of tha Philistines.

N David took tha shields of gold dat were on tha servants of Hadarezer, N brought ’em 2 Jerusalem.

19.text: Now it happened after dis, dat Nahash tha king of tha children of Ammon died, N his son reigned in his stead.

N when tha Syrians saw dat dey were put 2 tha worse before Israel, dey sent messengers, N drew forth tha Syrians dat were beyond tha river: N Shophach tha captain of tha host of Hadarezer went before ’em.

20.text: N it happened, dat after tha year was expired, at tha time dat kings go out 2 battle, Joab led forth tha power of tha army, N wasted tha country of tha children of Ammon, N came N besieged Rabbah. But David tarried at Jerusalem. N Joab struck Rabbah, N destroyed it.

Dese were born 2 tha giant in Gath; N dey fell by tha hand of David, N by tha hand of his servants.

21.text: N Satan stood up against Israel, N provoked David 2 number Israel.

N Joab answered, tha LORD make his people an hundred times so many more as dey be: but, my lord tha king, r dey not all my lord’s servants? why then does my lord require dis thing? why will he be a cause of trespass 2 Israel?

But Levi N Benjamin counted he not among ’em: 4 tha king’s word was abominable 2 Joab.
N God was displeased wit dis thing; therefore he struck Israel. concerning dis thing
N David said 2 God, I have sinned greatly, because I have done dis thing: but now, I beg u, do away tha iniquity of ur servant; 4 I have done very foolishly.
N tha LORD spoke 2 Gad, David’s seer, sayin,
Go N tell David, sayin, like dis says tha LORD, I offer u three things: choose u one of ’em, dat I may do it 2 u.
So Gad came 2 David, N said 2 him, like dis says tha LORD, Choose u

Also 4 tha courses of tha priests N tha Levites, N 4 all tha work of tha service of tha house of tha LORD, N 4 all tha vessels of service in tha house of tha LORD.
He gave of gold by weight 4 things of gold, 4 all instruments of all manner of service; silver also 4 all instruments of silver by weight, 4 all instruments of every kind of service:

Even tha weight 4 tha candlesticks of gold, N 4 their lamps of gold, by weight 4 every candlestick, N 4 tha lamps of it: N 4 tha candlesticks of silver by weight, both 4 tha candlestick, N also 4 tha lamps of it, according 2 tha use of every candlestick.
N by weight he gave gold 4 tha tables of showbread, 4 every table; N likewise silver 4 tha tables of silver:
Also pure gold 4 tha fleshhooks, N tha bowls, N tha cups: N 4 tha golden basons he gave gold by weight 4 every bason; N likewise silver by weight 4 every bason of silver:
N 4 tha altar of incense refined gold by weight; N gold 4 tha pattern of tha chariot of tha cherubims, dat spread out their wings, N covered tha ark of tha covenant of tha LORD.
All dis, said David, tha LORD made me understand in writing by his hand upon me, even all tha works of dis pattern.

N David said 2 Solomon his son, Be strong N of good courage, N do it: don’t fear, nor be dismayed: 4 tha LORD God, even my God, will be wit u; he will not fail u, nor forsake u, until u have finished all tha work 4 tha service of tha house of tha LORD.

N, look, tha courses of tha priests N tha Levites, even dey shall be wit u 4 all tha service of tha house of God: N there shall be wit u 4 all manner of workmanship every willin skilful man, 4 any manner of service: also tha princes N all tha people will be wholly at ur commandment.

29.text: Furthermore David tha king said 2 all tha congregation, Solomon my son, whom alone God has chosen, is yet young N tender, N tha work is great: 4 tha palace is not 4 man, but 4 tha LORD God.

Now I have prepared wit all my might 4 tha house of my God tha gold 4 things 2 be made of gold, N tha silver 4 things of silver, N tha brass 4 things of brass, tha iron 4 things of iron, N wood 4 things of wood; onyx stones, N stones 2 be set, glistering stones, N of divers colours, N all manner of precious stones, N marble stones in abundance.

Moreover, because I have set my affection 2 tha house of my God, I have of my own proper good, of gold N silver, which I have given 2 tha house of my God, over N above all dat I have prepared 4 tha holy house,
Even three thousand talents of gold, of tha gold of Ophir, N seven thousand talents of refined silver, 2 overlay tha walls of tha houses withal:
Tha gold 4 things of gold, N tha silver 4 things of silver, N 4 all manner of work 2 be made by tha hands of artificers. N who then is willin 2 consecrate his service dis day 2 tha LORD?
Then tha chief of tha fathers N princes of tha tribes of Israel, N tha captains of thousands N of hundreds, wit tha rulers of tha king’s work, offered willingly,

N gave 4 tha service of tha house of God of gold five thousand talents N ten thousand drams, N of silver ten thousand talents, N of brass eighteen thousand talents, N one hundred thousand talents of iron.
N dey wit whom precious stones were found gave ’em 2 tha treasure of tha house of tha LORD, by tha hand of Jehiel tha Gershonite.
Then tha people rejoiced, 4 dat dey offered willingly, because wit perfect heart dey offered willingly 2 tha LORD: N David tha king also rejoiced wit great joy.
So David blessed tha LORD before all tha congregation: N David said, Blessed be u, LORD God of Israel our father, 4 ever N ever.

Thine, O LORD, is tha greatness, N tha power, N tha glory, N tha victory, N tha majesty: 4 all dat is in tha heaven N in tha earth is thine; thine is tha kingdom, O LORD, N u r exalted as head above all.
Both riches N honour come of u, N u reign over all; N in thine hand is power N might; N in thine hand it is 2 make great, N 2 give strength 2 all.
Now therefore, our God, we thank u, N praise ur glorious name.
But who am I, N what is my people, dat we should be able 2 offer so willingly after dis sort? 4 all things come of u, N of ur own have we given u.
4 we r strangers before u, N sojourners, as were all our fathers: our days on tha earth r as a shadow, N there is none abiding.
O LORD our God, all dis store dat we have prepared 2 build u an house 4 thine holy name comes of thine hand, N is all ur own.

I know also, my God, dat u triest tha heart, N have pleasure in uprightness. As 4 me, in tha uprightness of mine heart I have willingly offered all dese things: N now have I seen wit joy ur people, which r present here, 2 offer willingly 2 u.
O LORD God of Abraham, Isaac, N of Israel, our fathers, keep dis 4 ever in tha imagination of tha thoughts of tha heart of ur people, N prepare their heart 2 u:
N give 2 Solomon my son a perfect heart, 2 keep ur commandments, ur testimonies, N ur statutes, N 2 do all dese things, N 2 build tha palace, 4 tha which I have made provision.
N David said 2 all tha congregation, Now bless tha LORD ur God. N all tha congregation blessed tha LORD God of their fathers, N bowed down their heads, N worshipped tha LORD, N tha king.

N dey sacrificed sacrifices 2 tha LORD, N offered burnt offerings 2 tha LORD, on tha morrow after dat day, even a thousand bullocks, a thousand rams, N a thousand lambs, wit their drink offerings, N sacrifices in abundance 4 all Israel:
N did eat N drink before tha LORD on dat day wit great gladness. N dey made Solomon tha son of David king tha second time, N anointed him 2 tha LORD 2 be tha chief governor, N Zadok 2 be priest.
Then Solomon sat on tha throne of tha LORD as king instead of David his father, N prospered; N all Israel obeyed him.
N all tha princes, N tha mighty men, N all tha sons likewise of king David, submitted themselves 2 Solomon tha king.
N tha LORD magnified Solomon exceedingly in tha sight of all Israel, N bestowed upon him such royal majesty as had not been on any king before him in Israel.
Like dis David tha son of Jesse reigned over all Israel.
N tha time dat he reigned over Israel was forty years; seven years reigned he in Hebron, N thirty N three years reigned he in Jerusalem.
N he died in a good old age, full of days, riches, N honour: N Solomon his son reigned in his stead.
Now tha acts of David tha king, first N last, look, dey r written in tha book of Samuel tha seer, N in tha book of Nathan tha prophet, N in tha book of Gad tha seer,
Wit all his reign N his might, N tha times dat went over him, N over Israel, N over all tha kingdoms of tha countries.
